_note: Shared config for components/decomposer/run_decomposer.py, and the MetaQA default (hops 1-3, the MetaQA question files, one question per line). Per-model prompt style, generation, loader, few-shot and post-processing settings live in components/decomposer/models/<model>/config.json. v1 carried these as argparse defaults inside each copy of decomposer.py. The MuSiQue experiment of issue #12 uses configs/decomposer_musique.json instead; 'condition' is null here, so the guided/unguided/capped condition machinery stays inert on this path and 'guided' alone decides.
